title: Settings
recentThemesHint: When off, the library hides recent themes and stops recording them.
hardwareAccelerationHint: Hardware acceleration applies the next time Theme Studio starts.
resetBody: Restore language, preview, and performance preferences? Open themes stay as they are.
dpiHint: Display scale {{scale}}. Electron stays per-monitor DPI aware.
fixedChrome: App appearance is chosen from the title bar. It does not follow the theme being edited.
